title: 908. Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid

examples.explanation: One extra ')' has no partner; adding a single '(' at the front balances it.
Three unmatched opens each need a closing partner.
The middle is balanced; the stray ')' needs one '(' and the two trailing '(' need two ')'.

hints: Track the current open balance: '(' raises it, ')' lowers it.
A ')' arriving at balance 0 has no partner, so count one needed '(' and keep the balance at 0.
Leftover open balance at the end needs that many ')' characters; add both counts.
